name: German
notes: Five fixed courses - the German minor names every one of them.

The program runs a four-week summer study-abroad in Berlin worth 4 credits that count toward or substitute for minor requirements, and awards one junior or graduating senior a fellowship-supported post-baccalaureate year at the University of Cologne.

requirementGroups.label: Required German courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The German minor has a total of 5 required courses. GRMN 151: Intermediate German I; GRMN 152: Intermediate German II; GRMN 200: Composition and Conversation; GRMN 202: Introduction to German Cultural Studies; GRMN 203: Introduction to German Literature
